answer_1.quote: Medical visual question answering (VQA) has emerged as a promising tool in computer-aided diagnosis, supporting clinical decision-making by generating answers to diagnostic questions based on medical images.
answer_1.outputs: generated answers to diagnostic questions based on medical images

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of the generated responses, we use four standard automatic metrics: BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, and CIDEr for the LLaVA-med dataset and accuracy for the VQA-RAD dataset.
